subject: af-dy
title: AF.DY.------POST.
description: Chart 1 of 3 on book p. 439 (TRF(CW)-11). AF-DY (affinity dynamics) is the subject; POST (postulation) is the partner. From the subject: INDIV-TD (individual tendencies), MT-INFO (multi-information) and PER-DY (perception dynamics). From INDIV-TD: EXP-DY (expansion dynamics) and ATTN (attraction). From ATTN: PART (participation). From MT-INFO: INFO-DE-B (information degrees) and C-CONT (composite continuance). From PER-DY: AFI (affinity insight). From AFI: SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics). From SPT-DY: APL-DT (application dictates).
